resources.string: Covers short videos while your coding agent works

Covers Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts and TikTok while your coding agent is working on your computer. Popups after a time limit can be switched on too. Android only wakes it for those three apps. It goes online for one thing only, and only if a computer linked it: to ask whether your coding agent is working.

resources.string: Send me to the home screen 10 minutes past the limit

Android tells it when Instagram, YouTube or TikTok changes screens, and it checks whether the short-video player is the one showing. It reads no text and takes no screenshots. If a computer linked it to your coding agent, it asks one address whether the agent is working, and only while a short video is in front. Nothing about this phone goes with the question, but the times it asks show the service when you watch short videos.
